title: David
textBlocks:
Hello Bravehearts
In today’s true Bible story, 
you will see that it is 
WHAT IS ON THE INSIDE
that matters!
Go to the house of Jesse and the Lord will tell him which son to choose
The Lord rejected all 7 of Jesse’s sons!

Samuel was confused. 
Do you have another son?

Send for him. We won’t eat till he gets here.
When David arrived he was healthy looking, 
he had beautiful eyes and a handsome appearance

BUT THE LORD WOULD MAKE HIM 
KING 
BECAUSE THE LORD COULD SEE HIS 
HEART
